{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|You are the prize I wanted the Rebels to find on this world. You are the key to ''Project Ambition'', and it will be their undoing.|Ysanne Isard|<ref name="XW 24">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 24|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 24]]</ref>}}
'''Project Ambition''' was the codename following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] plot to liquidate the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and dispose of Interim [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], which would give her complete control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Isard accomplished this by dividing Pestage and the Ruling Council (both physically and in terms of suspicions of allegiance), notably through the bumbling of the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal]] and by undermining the Council's support throughout the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].
